summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival game across Level 0's yellow maze, Level 1's Habitable Zone and Level 2's utility halls, with an isolated debug room. Shared player, camera and HUD systems link the places; their simulations generate supplies and threats while persistent player state carries progression, inventory and HALOGEN character data.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 maze and hub; authored cells hold props and lights, while sim.js creates maze features, loot, crates, smilers and lurkers.
places/level1 (3D) - Habitable Zone and M.E.G. camp; sim.js maintains supplies, agents, Flickering, hounds and stealers; cells hold camp and Level 2 utility-door entrance.
places/level2 (3D) - Abandoned Utility Halls; sim.js builds seeded tunnels, warehouse, supplies and Survivor camp, with hounds and survivor NPCs.
places/debug (3D) - isolated combat/loot test room; cells hold weapon/item stations, enemy pens, release pads and test stands.
places/level1 and places/level2 - transition destinations connected to Level 0 and each other by player exit and level-door triggers.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry, defaults to main and wires player/camera, inputs, lighting, arrival behavior, HUD and nametags.
templates/player.js - ordered player chain: humanoid-locomotion.js, player.js, interact.js, noclip.js, stats.js, then critter.js.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - look-oriented camera; camera script owns yaw/pitch and display-frame camera/viewmodel updates.
places/main/config.yaml + cells + sim.js - authored Level 0 cells and hub plus dynamic maze, loot and threats.
places/level1/config.yaml + cells + sim.js - Level 1 environment, camp, encounter loops and Level 2 entrance.
places/level2/config.yaml + sim.js - Level 2 spawn/atmosphere, seeded layout and camp/NPC simulation.
places/debug/config.yaml + cells + sim.js - isolated test room; sim restores its weapon and item stations and manages test pens.
scripts/ui.js + scripts/loot-ui.js + scripts/stats-ui.js + scripts/noclip-ui.js - HUD entry and looting, inventory, HALOGEN sheet/target/carry and noclip overlays.
shared: scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/data/level0.yml - canonical Level 0 grid, zones, walls, arches, hub, exit and tuning used by geometry, simulation and gameplay.
scripts/lib/level1.js + scripts/lib/data/level1.yml; scripts/lib/level2.js + scripts/lib/data/level2.yml - separate deterministic level layouts, zones, thresholds/doors and encounter tuning.

scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/lib/weapons.js - base weapon stats and variant definitions; weapons.js builds keyed kind/variant entries with adjusted combat and presentation fields for shared W readers.

scripts/lib/weapon-look.js + scripts/lib/weapon-prof.js + scripts/weapon-geo.js - shared fitted weapon bodies and variant overlays; prof records measured mesh frames, used by pickups, viewmodels and NPC attachments.
scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/loot.js - item-token vocabulary, descriptions/weights and pickup, crate, remains and level-specific loot rolls.
scripts/lib/stats.js - HALOGEN attributes/skills, derived modifiers, carry and NPC stat helpers used by player, UI, interactions and creatures.
scripts/lib/data/meg.yml + scripts/meg-agent.js - common combat, movement and agent behavior reused by Level 1 M.E.G. personnel and Level 2 Survivors.
scripts/critter-geo.js - procedural avatar/NPC rig reused by player appearance, wardrobe, agents and Survivors.
notableExports: places/main/sim.js, places/level1/sim.js, places/level2/sim.js and places/debug/sim.js - cadence, tick; places/level1/sim.js also agentSpec.
scripts/lib/weapons.js - default weapon/variant registry, baseOf, variantOf, rollVariant; scripts/lib/weapon-prof.js - MESHPROF.
scripts/lib/weapon-look.js - weaponBody; scripts/weapon-geo.js - geometry, collider; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
scripts/lib/items.js - itemsOf, tokenOf, describe; scripts/lib/loot.js - spawn/roll helpers for shared and level-specific loot, crates and remains.
scripts/lib/stats.js - ATTRS, SKILLS, SKILL_KEYS, ATTR_MAX, START, attrsOf, packAttrs, tagsOf, spentOf, baseSkill, skillsOf, wclass.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, takeToken, onInput, reload callbacks, pumpRack, update; scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber, update.
scripts/ui.js - default, plyUpload; scripts/loot-ui.js - lootUi; scripts/stats-ui.js - statsUi; scripts/stats.js - onInput, spend, update.
scripts/smilers.js, scripts/lurkers.js, scripts/hounds.js and scripts/stealers.js - update; scripts/meg-agent.js - onSpawn, update, vanish.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state owns level/XP, health/survival values, visited cells/zones, kills/escapes/deaths, weapon inventory, equipped kind/variant, ammunition, magazines and per-weapon condition; session state holds movement/combat/reload controls.
scripts/stats.js - player.state owns sheetOpen, target and HALOGEN attr/skl/apts/spts/tags fields; initializes/migrates the sheet and spends points.
scripts/interact.js - player.state focus, lootOpen, lootName, lootList, notice and NPC service cooldowns; container state owns item tokens and lock/scavenged fields.
scripts/critter.js - player.state.look owns avatar appearance; outfits stores saved looks and wardrobe controls; mood/blink/twitch and mirror/rebuild scratch is local/session state.
places/main/sim.js - main place.state owns seed/refill times and per-player shifted-wall timers; generated stairs, walls, loot, crates and enemies are entities.
places/level1/sim.js and places/level2/sim.js - place state owns seeded/camp and supply/respawn schedules; NPC and threat stats/health live on their entities.

scripts/smilers.js, scripts/lurkers.js, scripts/hounds.js, scripts/stealers.js and scripts/meg-agent.js - enemy/NPC entity state owns health/death, rolled stats, loot and behavior flags; sessions hold targeting/pathing scratch.
flows: world.config.yaml actions/axes → templates/player.js chain: locomotion reads prior movement; player.js writes movement/survival/combat; interact.js handles use; noclip.js handles arrival/exit; stats.js handles sheet; critter.js handles appearance.
world.config.yaml camera template → scripts/camera.js reads look input and owns yaw/pitch; movement, enemy gaze checks, target ray and viewmodel pose consume camera state/direction.
Level 0 exit in scripts/player.js → ctx.cross to level1; Level 1 BACK and Level 2 return triggers → scripts/level-door.js → main/level1; Level 1 utility doorway crosses to level2.
interact/reload input → scripts/interact.js focus/container handler → scripts/lib/items.js token vocabulary → scripts/player.js takeToken applies pickups; scripts/lib/stats.js enforces carry.
scripts/interact.js writes focus/lootOpen/lootList/notice → scripts/loot-ui.js via scripts/ui.js renders prompts and inventory; UI actions return to loot actions and R takes all.
place simulations and smiler deaths → scripts/lib/loot.js weighted kind selection and rollVariant → scripts/lib/weapons.js registry → weapon entity state.kind or player inventory key.
scripts/player.js reads variant W[k] for level gates, damage, ammo, condition, wear and reload; player pickup initializes variant condition and variant stats remain keyed by the full weapon id.

weapon entity/viewmodel/NPC attachment → scripts/lib/weapon-look.js weaponBody → base mesh or scripts/weapon-geo.js plus variant look/tint; scripts/lib/weapon-prof.js measured profiles align overlays to mesh shafts.
I inventory input → scripts/player.js owns invOpen and equip/drink/drop; scripts/lib/loot.js creates dropped weapon entities and scripts/loot-ui.js displays weapon names and rarity.
K sheet/stat action → scripts/stats.js toggles/spends and writes target → scripts/stats-ui.js renders sheet, carry and creature readout through scripts/ui.js.

scripts/player.js awards XP/levels and applies scripts/lib/stats.js derived modifiers; place simulations initialize NPC/enemy stats, and shared hounds/meg-agent behavior runs in its respective places.
wardrobe (C), emote (T), dress action → scripts/critter.js updates player.state.look/outfits → scripts/wardrobe-ui.js via scripts/ui.js; wardrobe model upload uses scripts/lib/plyimport.js.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* authored lights - fluorescent fixtures repeat across maze cells with red-zone variants; x-1z1 flicker-wall has chevrons, spatial buzz/crackle and local flicker/light state.

scripts/almond-geo.js, scripts/figure-geo.js, scripts/smiler-geo.js, scripts/lurker-geo.js, scripts/stairs-geo.js, scripts/weapon-geo.js, scripts/viewmodel-geo.js, scripts/level0-geo.js, scripts/level1-geo.js and scripts/level2-geo.js - procedural geometry builders for world props and actors.

scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - parallel Level 0 enemy loops share targeting, maze path/line checks, bite/death/effect patterns and rolled stats; smilers react to light/eye contact, lurkers to gaze and sanity.
scripts/hounds.js + scripts/hound-geo.js - shared Level 1/Level 2 hound behavior and model; safe zones vary by place.
scripts/stealers.js + scripts/stealer-geo.js - Level 1 managed wanderers reveal/attack and use common stat/death/loot conventions.

scripts/camera.js + scripts/lib/vmpose.js + scripts/player.js - first-person viewmodel pose varies with weapon recoil/reload/sight/muzzle and melee charge; base weapon controls grip offsets while variants retain base framing.

scripts/lib/weapons.js + scripts/lib/weapon-look.js + scripts/lib/weapon-prof.js + scripts/weapon-geo.js - all weapon kinds reuse base meshes/geometry with varied stat modifiers, condition, tint and measured-frame cosmetic overlays.
scripts/critter-geo.js and scripts/meg-agent.js - procedural critter looks and shared agent pathing/combat/talk/death behavior vary by species/look and NPC role, voice, gun and place.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - no active place uses it; all places have terrain off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/reed.js - no active terrain layers or placed references; terrain is off.
migrationNotes: Level grids are separate contracts: Level 0 is 56×56 cells at 4 m with hub cells 26–29; Level 1 is 30×30 at 8 m/cell and 4.2 m height; Level 2 is 24×24 at 5 m/cell and 3 m height; keep geometry, zones and spawn logic aligned.

Player behavior order is intentional: humanoid-locomotion.js before player.js, then interact.js, noclip.js, stats.js and critter.js; locomotion reads prior movement before player control writes velocity.

Weapon ids use kind or kind~variant everywhere a weapon kind is stored; use scripts/lib/weapons.js for full stat entries and baseOf for base-only geometry/pose framing. Preserve full ids for inventory, condition, magazine and entity state.

Tripo weapon meshes use +Z length and their fitted feet/origin frame; MESHPROF rows are [z,x,y,r] in the mesh's own frame, and overlays only fit profiled straight-frame meshes; slanted meshes carry variant through name/stats/tint.

HALOGEN state uses seven comma-separated attribute ratings and thirteen comma-separated spent skill values; tags are comma-separated skill keys and sver=2 identifies the skills schema. stats.js migrates older sheets.

Inventory/container contents are comma-separated item tokens; weapons may repeat and dropping removes one copy. Level-specific zone names are prefixed l1_/l2_; Level 2 camp is hound-safe and its BACK door returns to Level 1.
